title: ‘Circle K’ Robber Gives Cops a Run For Their Money
description:
A man was arrested after allegedly trying to rob a Circle K while wielding a hatchet and a knife in Albuquerque, New Mexico. Police took Jordon Vasquez, 34, into custody after multiple callers reported the man acting unruly at the gas station. When police arrived, however, Vaquez wasn’t ready to end his alleged crime spree there by hopping in his car, backing into a police car, and fleeing the scene. The suspect is then caught on body cameras in a nearby restaurant where officers rushed in and subdued the robbery suspect. Vasquez is now facing multiple charges including armed robbery and fleeing police. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
